dict.Distanța dintre rânduri, la textul scris: Line spacing, for text written on several lines (Shift + Enter starts a new line): 1 = normal, 2 = double
dict.Spațiul dintre litere, în miimi din mări: Letter spacing, in thousandths of the letter size: 0 = normal, more = letters further apart, minus = tighter
dict.Click unde vrei textul (sau trage o case: Click where you want the text (or drag a box: the lines wrap by themselves), type, then Enter; double-click a placed text to change it
dict.Retragerea primului rând al fiecărui par: First line indent of each paragraph, in image pixels (a paragraph ends with Shift+Enter)
dict.Spațiul în plus după fiecare paragraf, î: Extra space after each paragraph, in image pixels (a paragraph ends with Shift+Enter)
